Abjurations are protective spells. They create physical or magical barriers, negate magical or physical abilities, harm trespassers, or even banish the subject of the spell to another plane of existence.
This school represents magicians who work as security specialists, architects, bodyguards, and hazard responders.

Common spells used by Union Abjurers: (Dispel Magic) (Calm Wild Magic) (Shield) (Protection from Evil) (Alarm) (Selective Alarm) (Resist Energy) (Stoneskin) (Remove Curse)

entries.name: conjuration
entries.content:
Each conjuration spell belongs to one of five subschools. Conjurations transport creatures from another plane of existence to your plane (calling); create objects or effects on the spot (creation); channel positive energy to mend wounds (healing); bring manifestations of objects, creatures, or forms of energy to the caster (summoning); or transport creatures or objects over great distances (teleportation). Conjurers must take great caution not to summon things they cannot control; a common danger of the craft.

This school represents magicians who work as suppliers, labor foremen, travel agents, and first responders.

entries.name: divination
entries.content:
Divination spells enable you to learn secrets long forgotten, predict the future, find hidden things, and foil deceptive spells.

This school represents magicians who work as security specialists, sense therapists, detectives, and surveyors.

entries.name: enchantment
entries.content:
Enchantment spells affect the minds of others, influencing or controlling their behavior.

All enchantments are mind-affecting spells. Two subschools of enchantment spells grant you influence over a subject creature; charm and compulsion

entries.name: evocation
entries.content:
Evocation spells manipulate magical energy or tap an unseen source of power to produce a desired end. In effect, an evocation draws upon magic to create something out of nothing. Many of these spells produce spectacular effects, and evocation spells can deal large amounts of damage.

Despite the obvious fireballs, lightning bolts, and walls of raw arcane energy, this school also covers telekinesis, ley line repair, and electricians.

entries.name: illusion
entries.content: Illusion spells deceive the senses or minds of others. They cause people to see things that are not there, not see things that are there, hear phantom noises, or remember things that never happened.

entries.name: necromancy
entries.content: Necromancy spells manipulate the power of death, unlife, and the life force. Spells involving undead creatures certainly make up a sizeable part of this school, but they are rarely used outside of certain post-death plans made by the soon-to-be-deceased. Instead, exorcising and/or communicating with the dead and reversing sudden fatalities before the soul is taken away by whatever afterlife would take them.

entries.name: transmutation
entries.content: Transmutation spells change the properties of some creature, thing, or condition. This often covers transmuting matter into completely different matter, like turning hyper scat into silicon and gold or turning ash into wood. Gender therapy, polymorphing, mutation, and bio engineering are common disciplines practiced under Transmutation.
